hooks.name: Web: typecheck + lint on save
hooks.description: Runs the web TypeScript type-checker and ESLint whenever a .ts/.tsx file is saved. No-ops until web dependencies are installed under Node 20+.

action.command: if [ -d web ] && [ -d web/node_modules ]; then cd web && npm run -s typecheck && npm run -s lint; else echo "pigeonhole: web deps not installed yet (needs Node>=20.9 + npm install) — skipping"; fi
